subject.title: fix(process): Windows exec/read empty output when detached spawn leaks

question: Should OpenClaw globally forbid `detached: true` inside `spawnWithFallback` on Windows despite the current production caller already passing `false`, or require a traced fix only at the failing Gateway/session boundary?
rationale: The branch deliberately proposes a defense-in-depth policy change rather than a demonstrated repair for the current report, so a maintainer must choose whether that broader Windows contract is intended.

options.title: Require a traced boundary fix
options.body: Keep the linked bug open until a real Windows Gateway/session reproduction identifies the effective spawn or result-delivery boundary, then make the narrow repair there.

options.title: Adopt the global guard intentionally
options.body: Accept the broader Windows behavior change only after documenting why no legitimate current or future `spawnWithFallback` caller may need detached semantics.

options.title: Close this branch as unproven
options.body: Remove the utility override and let a future PR address the issue once the reported environment can be reproduced.

recommendation.title: Require a traced boundary fix
recommendation.body: Keep the linked bug open until a real Windows Gateway/session reproduction identifies the effective spawn or result-delivery boundary, then make the narrow repair there.

likelyOwner.reason: The available public history only supports steipete as a low-confidence routing candidate for current core-runtime direction.
